
'''Ōtsu Shrine''' (大津神社) refers to several Shinto shrines in Japan:

* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Hida)|ja|大津神社 (飛騨市)|qid=Q11437362}} - Located in Hida City, Gifu Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Ise)|ja|大津神社 (伊勢市)|qid=Q17222697}} - Located in Ise City, Mie Prefecture. A subsidiary shrine of {{ill|Tōyūke Daijingū|ja|豊受大神宮|1=Toyōke Daijingū|2=ja|3=豊受大神宮|4=zh|5=豐受大神宮|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tōyūke Daijingū|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyōke Daijingū|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, part of the 125 shrines of the {{ill|Ise Grand Shrine|en|Ise Shrine|qid=Q687168|lt=Ise Grand Shrine}}.
* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Izumi Ōtsu)|ja|大津神社 (泉大津市)}} - Located in Izumi Ōtsu City, Osaka Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Habikino)|ja|大津神社 (羽曳野市)|qid=Q11437361}} - Located in Habikino City, Osaka Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Higashi Ōsaka)|ja|大津神社 (東大阪市)}} - Located in Higashi Ōsaka City, Osaka Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Nishiwaki)|ja|大津神社 (西脇市)}} - Located in Nishiwaki City, Hyōgo Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Maniwa)|ja|大津神社 (真庭市)}} - Located in Maniwa City, Okayama Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtsu Shrine (Ōita)|ja|大津神社 (大分市)}} - Located in Ōita City, Ōita Prefecture.
